significance: A three-temple monastery complex in Bhutan's Bumthang valley, the oldest of whose shrines was raised by king Sindhu Raja beside a meditation cave. It also serves as the resting place of the remains of Bhutan's first three kings.
story: Oral tradition holds that Padmasambhava subdued the local deity Shelging Karpo here and left the imprint of his body in the cave, from which the site takes its name.
